name: Scarlet Monastery: Fairbanks never starts his area Sleep against a tank and healer duo
contract: High Inquisitor Fairbanks 4542 is a Scarlet Monastery (map 189, expansion 0) encounter boss. His Ascension kit
casts Sleep 8399 on himself (event 9002, target self, first after 25-27 s, then every 25-27 s): Spell.dbc targets
SRC_CASTER / SRC_AREA_ENEMY with radius index 8, so it sleeps every enemy within 5 yd of him. Vanilla dungeon
boss sleeps never reach a tank or healer specialization (BossControlTargeting.h): the area targets drop them, and
a sleep aimed at the boss himself starts only while a player who is neither is engaged. Every player gets Immune
Poly/Fear/ 28237 (mechanic immunity to polymorph, fear and root, not sleep), so his kit Fear 12096 cannot move
anyone out of the 5 yd radius. The fight is at the Cathedral entrance (areatrigger_teleport 610). The players are
level 40 humans, matching the boss. They group in Stormwind and teleport into one instance, where Fairbanks is
summoned 2 yd away at his own stats; player health fixtures keep everyone alive through the window. With only a
Vanguard 21 tank and a Grovekeeper 58 healer there is nobody the sleep may take, so it is never cast. A control
requires his kit Dispel Magic 15090 (every 5.4-5.9 s) in the same window.

steps.label: Let the characters finish logging in
healer joins tank's group
tank takes specialization 21
healer takes specialization 58
tank enters the dungeon
CONTROL: tank is inside the dungeon
healer enters the dungeon
CONTROL: healer is inside the dungeon
tank is immune to fear and roots, so Fairbanks' Fear cannot move them out of his sleep
healer is immune to fear and roots, so Fairbanks' Fear cannot move them out of his sleep
Summon the boss in the group's instance
Let the boss's spawn events settle
The tank engages first and keeps top threat
CONTROL: Fairbanks is in combat
The tank builds a threat lead
healer joins the threat list
Run through the first two Sleep windows
CONTROL: the boss's AI keeps casting (Dispel Magic 15090)
Fairbanks never casts his area Sleep without a damage dealer
The area Sleep never lands on the tank or the healer
